Purpose of the agreement

The purpose of this agreement is the provision of a personalized nutritional counseling service, which may include:

  • Initial nutritional assessment.
  • Analysis of dietary habits and lifestyle.
  • Development of an individualized nutrition plan.
  • Nutrition education.
  • Follow-up and adjustments according to progress.

The service is based on dietary recommendations and does not constitute a medical act.

Cancellations and rescheduling

Session cancellations or modifications must be communicated at least 24 hours in advance. If the patient does not attend the scheduled consultation and does not ask for cancellation nor rescheduling within time (24 hours in advance), the payment will not be refunded.

Such modifications can be requested by either the client or the professional, provided that justified reasons exist, and a new date will be agreed upon by both parties.

Results

The client understands that:

  • Results depend on multiple individual factors.
  • Specific outcomes regarding weight/composition/performance can't be guaranteed.
  • Adherence to the program is a determining factor.

All shared information will be treated confidentially in accordance with current data protection regulations. Both parties declare that they have read, understood, and voluntarily accepted the conditions of this agreement.
